subject: How to show only subset of database integrate with textAreaInput or fileInput

messages.author: 64e761d00123b9cc
messages.subject: How to show only subset of database integrate with textAreaInput or fileInput
parts:
Please help me.
I want to show the subset of my database only by Input (multiple lines) or file input.
For example,

If a database which is already in mysql looks like the below,

NAME   Value1   Value2
name1          1           A
name2          2           B
name3          3           C
name4          4           D
name5          5           E
...

Using  'textAreaInput' or 'fileinput' or any input options, I only show a table filtered out by the list of NAME.

Maybe Input look like
name3
name5
name10

then
the final output table will be

NAME   Value1   Value2
name3          3           C
name5          5           E
name10       10           G

However, the below script shows the table with the first input name (=name3) only. Any advise????
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
library(shiny)
library(DT)
library(RMySQL)

con <- dbConnect(MySQL(), user="root", password="startgap", host="localhost", dbname="TMapp")
toDisplay <- c("NAME","Value1","Value2")
toDownload <- c("NAME","Value1","Value2")


shinyUI <- fluidPage(
    titlePanel(title="", windowTitle="TMApp"),
   
    sidebarLayout(
        sidebarPanel(width=3,

                     h1(strong("TMApp v0.8")),

                     h3(strong("TM web App")),
                     
            br(),
           
      textAreaInput("namelist",label=h3("NAME List input"), value= "Enter name(s)"),
      submitButton("Submit"),
             ),
       
        mainPanel(
          textOutput('contents'),
                  tabsetPanel(

                              tabPanel("TM 21",
                                       DT::dataTableOutput("table1"),
                                       downloadButton("download1", "Download"))
                              )
                  )
        )
    )

shinyServer <- function(input, output) {
       
  # Tool variants
  sqlOutput1 <- reactive({
   
    sqlCode <- paste0('select NAME,Value1,Value2 from TMapp.dta21',
                      ' where NAME in ("',input$namelist,'")',
                      ';')
    sqlOutput <- dbGetQuery(con, sqlCode)
    return(sqlOutput)
   
  })
 
 
}

shinyApp(ui=shinyUI, server=shinyServer)
